title: A Border for the Drop
author: Orsen Crane
blurb: Astrid Eastwick, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
